coverage_asymmetry.finding: the two eviction-pressure/capacity cells record only undifferentiated latency_ms, so they cannot attribute time; the attribution-capable cells have no eviction pressure. No cell is both.

corrections_to_published_text.C40_268.4_ms: reproduces exactly as U10 p1 rep1 at L=1024 (268 ms), but it is the BOUNDARY REPEAT, not a cold prefill: the cold send at the same length is 531 ms. Never print 268.4 as cold-prefill cost.
corrections_to_published_text.C34_vs_here: C34 0.240736 ms/token is log-log (L^1.0520); this note's 0.229998 is linear OLS on the same rows. Consistent, differently parameterised, not a conflict.
corrections_to_published_text.S12_C60: 11.2344x is a TOKEN ratio. Measured in time on the same SGLang: G3 median ttft 439.5 ms vs TUNED 1612.6 ms = 3.6693x. The token framing overstates the latency penalty by 3.06x.

evidence.verification_of_own_claims: every figure above re-derived in this pass from experiments/context-cache/cells/*/*.jsonl; grep of state/logs/lat_derive.out matched all except formatting-only 8,305.00 vs 8305.00

assumptions: Scope taken as the on-disk measurement rows in experiments/context-cache/cells/ plus the published claims in papers/context-cache/ (CLAIMS.md, SERVING-BRIEF.md, MANUSCRIPT.md). Offline literature numbers in docs/serving-options/ were excluded from the derivation because no row backs them.
Median-of-medians used for the TUNED-vs-G3 comparison because the two cells share no paired turns; recorded in the note rather than silently presented as paired.
U9's six lengths treated as a fixed design, so the OLS slope is reported with its domain (1k-32k) and not extrapolated, per the automated tag rule against unsupportable metrics.
next_unit_hint: Two follow-ups, either of which needs a new card. (1) Timing cells M4/TUNED store only latency_ms; a small patch that also records ttft_ms+wall_ms would make every future eviction finding attributable to prefill vs queueing at no extra request cost. (2) The C40 wording and the S12 token-vs-time framing should go to an independent verifier before the manuscript cites either as a latency claim.
